mutants.name: State update commits without atomic inbox/outbox

mutants.name: Publisher sends directly without outbox
mutants.description: Message published directly over Kafka/network without transactional outbox pattern.

mutants.name: Synchronous mutation HTTP replaces Kafka
mutants.description: Service invokes downstream service synchronously over HTTP instead of asynchronous messaging.

mutants.name: Invalid message DLQ after partial domain update

mutants.name: Replay duplicates audit rows
mutants.description: Audit consumer lacks deduplication / idempotent projection on event stream replay.

mutants.name: Consumer restart loses/doubles observable effect
mutants.description: Consumer crash/restart leaves duplicate state updates or drops unprocessed messages without transactional inbox.

mutants.name: Shared database transaction across services
mutants.description: Services share a database connection/transaction violating service isolation boundaries.
